practice.title: Introducing yourself (sample)
text: Transcript: Guten Tag, mein Name ist Ali. Ich komme aus Indien. Ich lerne Deutsch.

practice.title: Introduce yourself
text: Prompt: Sagen Sie Ihren Namen, Ihr Land, Ihr Alter und Ihr Hobby.
Useful phrases: Ich heiße ... / Ich komme aus ... / Ich bin ... Jahre alt. / Mein Hobby ist ...

practice.title: Invitation email
text: Task: Write an email to a friend. Invite him to your birthday party. Say when and where it is.
Checklist: greeting, date and place, closing.
answers: Model: Lieber Tom, ich habe am Samstag Geburtstag. Die Party ist um 18 Uhr bei mir zu Hause. Kommst du? Viele Grüße, Neeraj

study.intro: A practical path to a German public university. Always confirm requirements, deadlines and fees on the official websites, because they change.
steps: Choose your programme and check its language and subject requirements.
Check how your degree is recognised and which documents the university needs.
Prepare your documents: certificates, transcripts, language proof, CV, motivation letter.
Apply through the university portal or uni-assist, before the deadline.
After admission: visa, blocked account, health insurance and housing.
